rows: Open a work order and provide occupational safety and health category cards.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Test comb, Test Plug type XRT-1
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay contact comb from the VT secondary terminals
Place the Test plug in place of the relay contact comb on the VT secondary terminals, gently, taking care that the Test plug entry guide matches
Connect the voltage injection terminals from the PHU-100 injection set to terminals 5, 6 on the Test Plug
Raise the voltage gradually until the relay disc moves
Reduce the voltage gradually to zero, then disconnect the PHU-100 injection set
Connect the Start terminals from the timer to terminals T1, T2 on the PHU-100 injection set
Connect the Stop terminals from the timer to terminals 1, 2 on the Test Plug
Set the PHU-100 injection set voltage to {Vop} 150%
Reduce the voltage gradually to zero, then disconnect the PHU-100 injection set
Reset all the signals on the relay
Withdraw the Test Plug from the relay
Fit the relay contact comb to the VT secondary terminals, then fit the relay cover

Introduction
The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Osama Fathy Abdel Karim; approved by Eng. Abdel Nasser Maarouf Ahmed, General Manager, endorsed by Eng. Ibrahim El-Shahat Ibrahim, Head of the Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Quality Sector and MPIS Coordinator at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order and provide occupational safety and health category cards. | 
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs. | 
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment. | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Test comb, Test Plug type XRT-1 | 
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA | 
PHU-100 voltage injection set | 
Millisecond Counter (Timer) Type MCS-5N | 
Test leads | 
Procedures to be Carried Out
Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay contact comb from the VT secondary terminals | 1.
Place the Test plug in place of the relay contact comb on the VT secondary terminals, gently, taking care that the Test plug entry guide matches | 2.
Connect the voltage injection terminals from the PHU-100 injection set to terminals 5, 6 on the Test Plug | 3.
Raise the voltage gradually until the relay disc moves | 4.
Record the relay operating value {Vop} | 5.
Reduce the voltage gradually to zero, then disconnect the PHU-100 injection set | 6.
Connect the Start terminals from the timer to terminals T1, T2 on the PHU-100 injection set | 7.
Connect the Stop terminals from the timer to terminals 1, 2 on the Test Plug | 8.
Set the PHU-100 injection set voltage to {Vop} 150% | 9.
Disconnect the PHU-100 injection set | 10.
Reset the timer | 11.
Connect the PHU-100 injection set | 12.
Record the time reading | 13.
Reduce the voltage gradually to zero, then disconnect the PHU-100 injection set | 14.
Reset all the signals on the relay | 15.
Withdraw the Test Plug from the relay | 16.
Fit the relay contact comb to the VT secondary terminals, then fit the relay cover | 17.
